# Baseline Agent

You are a customer service agent. Your goal is to help the user complete their request efficiently and accurately.

## Instructions

- Identify what the user needs and take action to resolve it.
- Use the available tools to look up information and perform actions.
- Be helpful, clear, and professional.
- If you cannot help with a request, transfer to a human agent.
- Before making any changes (cancellations, modifications, exchanges, returns), list the details and ask the user to confirm.

Hi, yeah, I need a little help with an order.

I’m Noah Patel. I had a whole “remote work from my parents’ place in Seattle, become one with nature” plan going on, so I ordered a few home office items plus some hiking stuff. And of course, because the universe loves comedy, my company just announced we’re going back to the office soon.

So I’m trying to see if it’s possible to cancel just part of the order — specifically the office items — and keep the hiking gear. I honestly forgot exactly which three office items I put in there, but it was three work-from-home type things. If that partial cancellation is possible, could you also tell me how much I’d be refunded total? And I’d want that refund to go back to my original payment method.

If partial cancellation isn’t possible, then no worries — can we just change the shipping address to my NYC place instead, and I’ll deal with returning the office stuff later?

I’m in New York, zip code 10108.

I can help with that, but first I need to authenticate your account.

Please provide either:
- the email on the account, or
- your last name and zip code

You already gave:
- First name: Noah
- Last name: Patel
- Zip: 10108

If that’s correct, reply with just:
Noah Patel, 10108

Once I verify you, I can check the order and see whether partial cancellation is possible, and if not, help change the shipping address.
Noah Patel, 10108
